facts: Model.infer sums session prepare/encode/gpu/wait after each decoder.step, not the first prefill prediction.
The session encodes all decoder layers, hidden copy, vocabulary head and greedy argmax before SubmitAndWait; gpu_ms does not isolate head versus body.
SubmitAndWait reports lastGPUend-firstGPUstart across the current/prior command buffers, including inter-command gaps; it is a span, not a sum of per-kernel durations.
wait_ms is host elapsed after encoding through completion/accounting and overlaps GPU span; do not add them.

decode_seconds includes the loop/embedding/marshalling/native steps before post-decode telemetry. Derived decode from total-TTFT additionally includes post-loop work and possible extraEOS native steps; not pure GPU tokens/s.
scope: Read-only source audit during speed worker; no source changes, added GPU instrumentation or competing inference. Per-kernel/ALU/bandwidth/occupancy attribution remains unproven.
